caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular grandfather clock made primarily of a reddish-brown wood with gold or brass accents outlining the front door panel and corners. The clock has a large, square face featuring black Roman numerals and two black hands for the hours and minutes, each with ornate detailing. The face is labeled "David Wood Newburyport" in black script at the center. Surrounding the clock face, especially in the upper corners, is a decorative, yellow geometric pattern. Above the clock face is an arched section containing a painted scene showing two robed figures, one standing and one kneeling, set outdoors with trees and sky in the background. The top of the clock case is ornate, rising in a smooth arch with a small gold rectangle centered in the upper crest. The sides of the clock's upper section have oval openings. The lower half of the clock is mainly a large, rectangular door with a gold border, and the base features bracket feet with gently inward-curving arches. The name "ULRICH FISCHER" and "LORENZ KOSTHEIM" are written at the bottom left corner of the drawing. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white.
title: Mantel Clock
